NewsArticle.Title: Internet Connection
NewsArticle.Content: 04.25 10:27am-2pm PDT Internet Service Provider near Dark Ages servers is suffering a major router error. This impairs several ISP connections to Dark Ages game and web servers. If your connection is poor, be safe. Do not risk game death by disconnection. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
